diagnostics.message: google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member.service_identity_cmek lists google_project.project in depends_on, but its `member` argument references local.service_accounts_robots -> local.project.number -> google_project.project.0.number, so an implicit dependency on google_project.project already exists. The explicit depends_on is redundant.

google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member.service_identity_cmek lists data.google_project.project in depends_on, but its `member` argument references local.service_accounts_robots -> local.project.number -> data.google_project.project.0.number, so the same ordering is already established implicitly. The explicit depends_on is redundant.

google_essential_contacts_contact.contact creates contacts on the project (parent = "projects/${local.project.project_id}") but has no dependency on google_project_service.project_services. The Essential Contacts API (essentialcontacts.googleapis.com) must be enabled on the project before a contact can be created, so if it is included in var.services this resource can fail intermittently on first apply.
